scope: R1 candidate, not current released board

pin_contract.existing: RESET1 pin15 -> GUARD_RESET_N -> 68k pullup to 3V3_SVS, 1M pulldown, U_GUARD_BUF 1G17 input; buffer powered 3V3_GUARD and output GUARD_OK -> UCC IN+
pin_contract.shared: RESET2/3 pin16/17 -> SC_RAIL_OK; RESET4 pin18 -> LPV_QUAL_LOCAL; never sever existing destinations
pin_contract.proposal: Q_CLAMP C=DUMP_SW_BASE E=GND B=CLAMP_B via 100k to 12V_PROT; Q_RELEASE C=CLAMP_B E=GND B=REL_B via 10k from LPV_DRV_LOCAL and 100k to GND; diode anodes REL_B, cathodes SC_RAIL_OK and LPV_QUAL_LOCAL
pin_contract.hardware: Q_PMOS_CTRL C remains DUMP_OFF, but R1 UCC IN+=GUARD_OK; GUARD low prevents driver action even on hard OV

reset1_por.warning: 5uA is an input-leakage specification at its own endpoint, not a guarantee that this exact node injects 5uA. Additional line/input leakage consumes same budget.

diode_or.conclusion: 0.64V is not guaranteed Q_RELEASE off; 0.4V reset and 0.24V diode values belong to different current/temperature test conditions and cannot be summed as a full-temperature bound.

bounds.supervisor_por: 0.9V, 15uA, VOL<=0.2V, rising slew >=15us/V; not a falling/reset guarantee

failure_scenarios: Startup: GUARD rail can precede filtered SVS rail; without valid reset and output state, GUARD high before qualification is not excluded by the 0.9V point.
Short dip: SENSE pulses below 4us in the specified test cannot be guaranteed detected; release delay only follows a detected reset.
GUARD remains valid high after CORE/5V loss until detection, diode and transistor propagation complete; Q_RELEASE must stay off throughout, not merely after settling.
GUARD low blocks UCC; hard OV request does not imply MOS conduction or energy absorption.
needed: Guarantee supervisor 0-to-valid output versus both rails and slew, RESET sink including both diodes and existing loads, max diode voltage at actual current/temperature, Q_RELEASE collector leakage versus VBE and temperature, clamp sink and switching storage bounds, and detection-to-safe timing for allowed shortest dips.
